coordinate_convention: Zero-based, half-open genomic intervals; routing positions are offsets within each 12,800-bp window.
selection: Eight annotation-rich candidates per species and example type were screened using actual earliest-to-final checkpoint routing changes. Each displayed window maximizes a binned routing-change score within that shortlist; these are illustrative examples, not representative population estimates.
annotations: Region labels from the existing GENCODE datasets; NIG and DIG merged as Intergenic only for display. Tandem repeats annotated post hoc using TRF 2 7 7 80 10 50 500.
